hooks.command: echo Checking for dangerous commands... && if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_command" | grep -qE '(rm -rf|git reset --hard|git push --force)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Potentially destructive command detected. This hook prevents dangerous operations."; exit 1; fi

PreToolUse.matcher: source.path ends with:.env or source.path ends with:.env.local

hooks.command: echo WARNING: Writing to a .env file. Ensure secrets are not committed. Use .env.example for templates.

PreToolUse.matcher: source.path ends with:package.json or source.path ends with:requirements.txt

hooks.command: echo WARNING: Dependency file changed. Remember to pin versions and run security audits.

echo Running formatter on edited file... && (npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_RESULT_PATH" --config .prettierrc 2>/dev/null || echo "No formatter available or file not formatted.")
echo Running final quality checks... && (npm run lint 2>/dev/null && npm run test 2>/dev/null || echo "Run lint and tests manually if npm scripts not configured.")
